spans.s: पथ m. A way, a road.
पाथ (I) m. 1. Fire; 2. the sun.
पाथ (II) n. Water.
पथ-कल्पना f. juggling tricks.
पथिक m. 1. A traveller, a way-farer, Megh.i.8, Sr.
, Am.
; 2. a guide.
पथिक-संतति, -संहति ऋ।, -सार्थ म्। f. a company of travellers, a caravan.
पथिक-संतति, -संहति ऋ।, -सार्थ म्। f. a company of travellers, a caravan.
पथिक-सार्थ m. a company of travellers, a caravan.

पथिन् m. (nom. पंथाः-नौ-नः; acc. pl. पथः) (this word is changed into पथ at the end of compounds, तोयाधारपथाभ वल्कलशिखानिष्यंदरेखांकिताः Sak.i.) 1. A path, a way, वक्रः पंथा यदपि भवतः प्रस्थितस्तोत्तराशाम् Megh.i.27, R.iii.19; 2. a journey, e.g. शिवास्ते संतु पंथानः; 3. course, manner, course of action, पथः श्रुतेर्दर्शायितार ईश्वरा मलीमसामाददते न पद्धतिम् R.iii.46; 4. a sect, a doctrine.
पथिन्-देय n. a toll levied on public roads.
पथिन्-प्रज्ञ a. acquainted with roads.
पथिन्-वाहक (I) a. cruel.
पथिन्-वाहक (II) m. 1. a fowler; 2. a burden-bearer.
पथिल m. A traveller, a way-farer.
पथ्य (I) a. (f. थ्या) 1. Wholesome, salutary, beneficial (as diet or advice), Yaj.iii.65; 2. fit, proper, suitable.
पथ्य (II) n. 1. Wholesome diet; 2. well-being, welfare.
पथ्य (I) a. (f. थ्या) 1. Wholesome, salutary, beneficial (as diet or advice), Yaj.iii.65; 2. fit, proper, suitable.
पथ्य-अपथ्य n. the class of things that are considered beneficial or hurtful in disease.
पाथस् n. 1. Water; 2. food; 3. air.
पाथोज n. 1. a lotus; 2. the conch.
पाथोद m. a cloud.
पाथोद m. a cloud.
पाथोधि m. the ocean.
पाथोधि m. the ocean.
पाथेय n. 1. Provisions for a journey, viaticum, जग्राह पाथेयमिवेंद्रसूनुः Kir.iii.37, Megh.i.11; 2. the sign Virgo of the zodiac.
